# Stenmont

> Stenmont lets a business accept USDT payments on Whitechain without touching crypto: the customer pays with a passkey (no wallet, no gas), the business gets invoices, refunds, subscriptions and an accountant export. This is the test network (test USDT, no real money). Full reference in one file: https://app-staging.stenmont.com/llms-full.txt

Facts an agent needs:
- API base: https://api-staging.stenmont.com . Auth: "Authorization: Bearer $STENMONT_API_KEY" (server side only; never in browser code, never in a repository, never in a chat).
- Every POST to /v1/ needs an "Idempotency-Key" header.
- Take a payment: POST /v1/invoices with {"amount": "25.00", "successUrl", "cancelUrl", "metadata": {"order": "..."}}, then send the customer to the "payUrl" in the response.
- Webhooks: header "Stenmont-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>"; v1 is HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with STENMONT_WEBHOOK_SECRET; reject if t is more than 300 seconds old. Environment names: STENMONT_API_KEY, STENMONT_WEBHOOK_SECRET, STENMONT_API_URL.
- To install on a site, the owner opens https://app-staging.stenmont.com/dashboard/connect , copies the prompt for their platform and gives it to you. Finish only when the page shows all four checks green.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs): take a first payment in minutes
- [API](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/api): authentication, invoices, errors, idempotency
- [Webhooks](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/webhooks): events, retries, verifying the signature in Node and Python
- [SDK and React](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/sdk): server client and the Pay button
- [MCP](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/mcp): let an agent read invoices and draft refunds
- [x402](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/x402): charge or pay AI agents per request

## Optional

- [Full reference as one text file](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/llms-full.txt): every code sample, all events and error codes
- [Connect your site](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/dashboard/connect): prompts per platform and the status checks (sign-in required)
